about: Skill packs (2026-11-06). 'base' is always on. Every other pack is off for a new stack and is switched on by the person (/paquete NAME si) or by the operator. A skill that is in no pack (one the agent or the person made) is never touched. A skill in several packs stays on while any of them is on. hermes-agent can never be switched off (Hermes refuses).
